method_reference.role: Read-only method evidence; three explicit genre slots are creator's new 666TDI refinement, not asserted LYVRA rule

genre_front.metadata_prefix: Optional explicit BPM and relevant key, then immediately three distinct positive dark-psychedelic genre anchors before any other descriptive clauses.
genre_front.slot_2_3: Two distinct contextually appropriate dark psychedelic musical genres; examples below are open, not rotation
genre_front.gate: HOLD if either final field lacks three distinct leading positive anchors including R05 root, or intervening descriptive text displaces them. Repair then recheck. No silent truncation. Explicit experimental scope per R05 is not production approval.
genre_front.position_evidence: Early priority is a native empirical working assumption, not official Suno weighting proof.

LOW.role: Physical time authority and forward traction
LOW.rule: Motor identity is function, not identical sound. Straight rolling 16ths are a useful baseline, not universal preset. Local alternative pulses require current musical reason and clear timing.

LOWER_MID.role: Motor-linked rhythmic orientation and bass-adjacent support
LOWER_MID.rule: Retain enough connection to physical grid; not fixed EQ boundaries or 50/50 ratio.

UPPER_MID.role: Creative transformation, thematic sound dialogue, directed chaos, motif mutation
UPPER_MID.rule: Allow irregular accents, acid/FM or other relevant voices; protect intelligibility and do not imply mandatory instrumentation.

HIGH.rule: May create apparent acceleration, reversal, depth, orbit or surprise without real tempo drift or loss of physical orientation. No guaranteed stereo rear localization.

relations.principle: All fields communicate reciprocally; LOW owns real time, not total compositional authority. High events may provoke partial MID escalation; MID can reshape perceived motor pressure; LOW can support or contrast events through intentional dynamics without losing temporal identity.
relations.psychoacoustics: R09 cross-cutting dimension, not isolated HIGH-only effect. Preserve lower-field stability while selectively amplifying, attenuating and redirecting perception.
relations.chaos: Wildness retains meaningful differences and direction; no flattening or arbitrary genre drift.
relations.repair: If movement undermines physical timing or masks the kick, relocate or reshape only offending relationship; preserve artistic tension. No automatic rewrite of creator intent.

assembly: Check final literal prompts for genre front, individual functional motor/MID/HIGH cues, R06 integrated maximum clean club mastering, R07 lyrical isolation, R09 meaningful chaos and psychoacoustic language when relevant, UTF16 limits, meaningful emojis and ending. No internal pseudo-commands. Compare actual preceding prompt pairs for anti-sameness; shared root and time authority are not novelty or proof of sameness.
preserve: NMI-R01–R09 and prior files, R1.4 Python source, isolated R1.5 candidate, native identities
implementation: GPT-native additive contract; no Python or renderer execution claimed
